insight.title: Northbridge Executes Quick 12-Second Counterattack Goal
insight.canonical_claim: Northbridge Athletic regained the ball by interception in the middle third and scored a goal 12.0 seconds later after 4 passes or carries advancing 36.3 metres.
insight.why_it_matters: This sequence highlights Northbridge's ability to rapidly transition from defense to attack, creating scoring opportunities efficiently.
insight.uncertainty: This does not establish whether the counterattack was planned or the opposition was out of position.

observed_facts.statement: At 71', Northbridge Athletic's #9 N. Vantreight intercepted the ball in the middle third at location (39.7, 52.5).

Following the interception, Northbridge completed 3 passes: from #9 N. Vantreight to #8 O. Achterberg, then to #10 L. Ferrandi, and back to #9 N. Vantreight, advancing the ball significantly towards the opponent's goal.
#9 N. Vantreight carried the ball forward from near (7.1, 32.1) to (3.0, 33.1) before taking a shot.
The sequence ended with #9 N. Vantreight shooting from location (3.4, 32.8) resulting in a goal.
